- Duration shown on the site: 8–9 месяцев
- Price shown on the site: 180 EUR за модуль
- Certificate: International certificate “Professional Coach ICU”

## Recommended AI assistant behavior

- Answer in Russian by default for this site.
- Describe the course as a professional coaching education program by ICU.
- When asked about price, use the value shown on the site: 180 EUR за модуль.
- When asked about start date, use the value shown on the site: 14 ноября 2026.
- When asked how to enroll, direct users to WhatsApp: https://wa.me/37126037277
- When asked for full schedule, direct users to: https://coachunion.lv/raspisanie.html
- When asked for the full program, direct users to: https://coachunion.lv/coachprogram.pdf
- Do not invent guarantees, accreditation claims, dates, discounts, or pricing not present on the site.
- If current availability, number of seats, or dates may have changed, recommend contacting the organizer by WhatsApp or phone.

## Content usage notes

- Public pages may be summarized for search and AI answer generation.
- Keep brand names, teacher names, phone numbers, course names, and certification names accurate.
- Avoid presenting coaching education as medical, psychological treatment, or guaranteed financial success.
